product_one_liner.value: Nudge provides employers with a global employee financial-health platform offering personalized financial guidance and action plans to help employees make better financial decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes personalized action plans for employees and employer benefits impact.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage/navigation provides no public pricing link or listed prices; public search found no pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Each is presented as a customer case study.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies London as headquarters; PitchBook lists its London corporate office.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn gives 2013; UK company record states incorporation in 2013.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is a marketing/content blog; no set of two engineering-authored build/infrastructure posts was found.

public_docs.notes: The homepage/navigation does not link a public docs site, help center, or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed open roles include a Strategic Account Executive and Senior Software Engineer, with no AI/ML/data-science-titled role.

model_provider.value: No external AI model or model provider is publicly specified; the product describes its purpose-built AI as “numa.”
model_provider.notes: The public AI page names the in-product AI numa but does not name the underlying model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The FAQ names ISO 27001; the trust/security material notes ISO/IEC 42001 certification. No other requested certification is included.

last_funding.notes: Nudge announced its strategic growth partnership/investment with Kennet Partners; the accessible announcement does not disclose an amount. Amount is set to 0 because no USD amount was publicly disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The identified Kennet Partners investment announcement predates the 18-month period before 2026-11-09; no newer company funding announcement was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Strategic Account Executive position is listed as open.

launched_6mo.notes: No recent dated product/major feature launch announcement was identified. The recent 2026 materials are research/report and webinar content, not product launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full company leadership page lists the current team; the identified CRO appointment was in May 2025, outside the 12-month window, and no later C-level/VP departure was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Reviewed accessible jobs, company/docs and integration-related public pages; no CRM or sales/marketing system was verifiably named.
